query:
SELECT 
                b.balance as current_token_amount,
                a.account_id,
                a.nickname,
                a.image_uri,
                a.follower_count,
                a.following_count,
                ax.x_handle,
                ax.x_image_uri,
                ax.is_blue_label
            FROM balance b
            JOIN account a ON b.account_id = a.account_id
            LEFT JOIN account_x ax ON a.account_id = ax.account_id
            WHERE b.token_id = $1 AND b.balance > 0
            ORDER BY b.balance DESC
            OFFSET $2 LIMIT $3
